title: Token provisioning request received
description: All network calls to Pismo for tokenization (usually originating from a payment app such as Apple Pay), generate an event, allowing you to track token provisioning through creation to deletion. See the Cards tokenization flow and events guide for more information.

network_call_method.title: Network call method
network_call_method.description: Network outbound method identifier, serves to parse raw message from network_data

network_data.title: Network data
network_data.description: Raw data from network. Varies according to flow and network brand

network_event_out_of_order.title: Out-of-Order Network Event
network_event_out_of_order.description: Set to true if the event, as received from the Network, is out of the expected sequence; this condition may impact the token provisioning flow.

token.title: Token
token.description: Network token associated with card tokenization.

bin.title: BIN
bin.description: Card BIN associated with the tokenized card.

token_requestor_id.title: Token Requestor ID
token_requestor_id.description: Identifier of the token requestor in the network.

token_unique_reference.title: Token Unique Reference
token_unique_reference.description: Network-provided unique reference for the token.

send_challenge.title: Send Challenge
send_challenge.description: The object should be present when issuer it is responsible for sending OTP challenge to issuer.

otp_value.title: The OTP value
otp_value.description: issuer must send this value to cardholder using the chosen otp_method

otp_method.title: One time passcode method
otp_method.description: OTP (one-time passcode) challenge customer selected for token provisioning.

pismo_response.title: Pismo response
pismo_response.description: Pismo response to payment network. Response depends on network payment and `network_call_method`. Logs the final response from Pismo to the network payment. Should be null in async network calls that expect null values.
